form.label: API End-to-End Call Monitoring
form.description: Trace API requests from entry point to downstream dependency and final response. Select a problem trace to inspect its complete lifecycle and raw logs.

search.query: $index_name$ | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "(?i)(?:trace[_-]?id|correlation[_-]?id|request[_-]?id|transaction[_-]?id)[\"'=:\s]+(?<trace_extracted>[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128})" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "(?i)(?:http[_-]?status|status[_-]?code|response[_-]?code|status)[\"'=:\s]+(?<status_extracted>[1-5][0-9]{2})" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "(?i)(?:duration[_-]?ms|elapsed[_-]?ms|response[_-]?time[_-]?ms|latency[_-]?ms)[\"'=:\s]+(?<duration_extracted>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "(?i)(?:method|http[_-]?method|request[_-]?method)[\"'=:\s]+(?<method_extracted>GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS)" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "(?i)(?:uri|url|path|endpoint|route|request[_-]?uri)[\"'=:\s]+(?<endpoint_extracted>/(?:[^\s\"']+))" | eval trace_id=coalesce(trace_id, traceId, correlation_id, correlationId, request_id, requestId, transaction_id, transactionId, trace_extracted) | eval endpoint=coalesce(endpoint, request_uri, uri, path, route, url, api, endpoint_extracted) | eval http_method=upper(coalesce(http_method, request_method, method, method_extracted)) | eval http_status=coalesce(http_status, status_code, response_code, status, status_extracted) | eval duration_ms=round(tonumber(coalesce(duration_ms, response_time_ms, elapsed_ms, latency_ms, duration_extracted)),2) | eval service_name=coalesce(service_name, service, app, application, component, container_name, source) | eval environment=coalesce(environment, env, namespace, project, cluster) | eval pod=coalesce(pod, pod_name, kubernetes_pod_name, host) | eval downstream=coalesce(downstream, downstream_service, target_service, peer_service, destination, db_host) | eval event_stage=coalesce(stage, span_name, operation, event, action, logger_name, component) | eval api_message=coalesce(message, msg, error_message, exception, _raw) | eval status_num=tonumber(http_status) | eval is_api=if(isnotnull(endpoint) OR isnotnull(http_method) OR isnotnull(http_status) OR match(_raw,"(?i)\b(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)\s+/|HTTP/[12]\.[01]|REST|API"),1,0) | where is_api=1 | eval api_outcome=case( match(_raw,"(?i)timeout|timed out|connection reset|connection refused"),"TIMEOUT", status_num>=400,"FAILURE", status_num>=200 AND status_num<400,"SUCCESS", match(coalesce(log_level,level,severity,""),"(?i)error|fatal|critical"),"FAILURE", true(),"UNKNOWN") | eval is_slow=if(isnotnull(duration_ms) AND duration_ms>=tonumber("$slow_threshold$"),1,0) | eval api_outcome=if(api_outcome="SUCCESS" AND is_slow=1,"SLOW",api_outcome) | eval endpoint=coalesce(endpoint,"UNKNOWN_ENDPOINT"), http_method=coalesce(http_method,"UNKNOWN"), http_status=coalesce(http_status,"NO_CODE") | search environment="$environment_filter$" (service_name="$service_filter$" OR pod="$service_filter$") endpoint="*$endpoint_filter$*" | where "$outcome_filter$"="*" OR api_outcome="$outcome_filter$" | fields _time trace_id endpoint http_method http_status status_num duration_ms service_name environment pod downstream event_stage api_message api_outcome is_slow _raw

html.div: How to use: choose the application index and time range, then click a row in Problem Traces. The selected correlation ID populates the lifecycle and raw-log panels below. For accurate E2E tracing, the same ID must be logged by every participating service.

search.query: | stats count AS total count(eval(api_outcome="SUCCESS" OR api_outcome="SLOW")) AS ok | eval value=if(total=0,0,round(100*ok/total,2)) | fields value
| stats count(eval(api_outcome="FAILURE" OR api_outcome="TIMEOUT")) AS value
| stats perc95(duration_ms) AS value | eval value=round(value,2)
| stats count AS total count(trace_id) AS traced | eval value=if(total=0,0,round(100*traced/total,2)) | fields value

chart.title: API Calls Over Time by Outcome

search.query: | timechart span=5m count BY api_outcome limit=0 useother=f
| timechart span=5m avg(duration_ms) AS Average perc95(duration_ms) AS P95 | foreach Average P95 [eval <<FIELD>>=round('<<FIELD>>',2)]

table.title: Endpoint Health — locate the failing or slow API

search.query: | stats count AS Calls count(eval(api_outcome="SUCCESS" OR api_outcome="SLOW")) AS Successful count(eval(api_outcome="FAILURE")) AS Failures count(eval(api_outcome="TIMEOUT")) AS Timeouts avg(duration_ms) AS Avg_ms perc95(duration_ms) AS P95_ms max(duration_ms) AS Max_ms latest(_time) AS Last_seen BY http_method endpoint | eval Success_pct=round(100*Successful/Calls,2), Avg_ms=round(Avg_ms,2), P95_ms=round(P95_ms,2), Max_ms=round(Max_ms,2), Last_seen=strftime(Last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - Failures - Timeouts - P95_ms | table http_method endpoint Calls Success_pct Failures Timeouts Avg_ms P95_ms Max_ms Last_seen
| stats count BY http_status | sort - count

| where isnotnull(duration_ms) | sort 0 - duration_ms | head 20 | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table Time trace_id service_name pod http_method endpoint http_status api_outcome duration_ms downstream

table.title: Problem Traces — click a row for end-to-end investigation

search.query: | where api_outcome="FAILURE" OR api_outcome="TIMEOUT" OR api_outcome="SLOW" | where isnotnull(trace_id) | stats earliest(_time) AS Started latest(_time) AS Last_seen values(api_outcome) AS Outcome values(service_name) AS Services values(pod) AS Pods values(http_method) AS Method values(endpoint) AS Endpoint values(http_status) AS Status max(duration_ms) AS Max_ms values(downstream) AS Downstream BY trace_id | eval Started=strftime(Started,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), Last_seen=strftime(Last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), Max_ms=round(Max_ms,2) | sort 0 - Last_seen | table trace_id Started Last_seen Outcome Services Pods Method Endpoint Status Max_ms Downstream

html.div: Selected trace: $trace_filter$. Events below are ordered chronologically to show where the call slowed down or failed.

search.query: $index_name$ "$trace_filter$" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "(?i)(?:http[_-]?status|status[_-]?code|response[_-]?code|status)[\"'=:\s]+(?<status_extracted>[1-5][0-9]{2})" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "(?i)(?:duration[_-]?ms|elapsed[_-]?ms|response[_-]?time[_-]?ms|latency[_-]?ms)[\"'=:\s]+(?<duration_extracted>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "(?i)(?:method|http[_-]?method|request[_-]?method)[\"'=:\s]+(?<method_extracted>GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS)" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "(?i)(?:uri|url|path|endpoint|route|request[_-]?uri)[\"'=:\s]+(?<endpoint_extracted>/(?:[^\s\"']+))" | eval Service=coalesce(service_name,service,app,application,component,container_name,source) | eval Pod=coalesce(pod,pod_name,kubernetes_pod_name,host) | eval Method=upper(coalesce(http_method,request_method,method,method_extracted)) | eval Endpoint=coalesce(endpoint,request_uri,uri,path,route,url,api,endpoint_extracted) | eval Status=coalesce(http_status,status_code,response_code,status,status_extracted) | eval Duration_ms=round(tonumber(coalesce(duration_ms,response_time_ms,elapsed_ms,latency_ms,duration_extracted)),2) | eval Downstream=coalesce(downstream,downstream_service,target_service,peer_service,destination,db_host) | eval Detail=coalesce(message,msg,error_message,exception,event,action,operation,span_name) | eval Lifecycle_stage=case( match(_raw,"(?i)ingress|gateway|load balancer|received request"),"1. Request entry", match(_raw,"(?i)authentication|authorization|oauth|token|jwt"),"2. Authentication", match(_raw,"(?i)outbound|downstream|external api|http client|rest client"),"4. Downstream API", match(_raw,"(?i)database|datasource|jdbc|sql|oracle|stored procedure"),"5. Database", match(_raw,"(?i)timeout|exception|error|failed|failure|http[_ ]?5[0-9]{2}"),"6. Failure", match(_raw,"(?i)response|completed|returned|sent response"),"7. Final response", true(),"3. Application processing") | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N") | sort 0 _time | streamstats count AS Step | table Step Time Lifecycle_stage Service Pod Method Endpoint Downstream Status Duration_ms Detail

table.title: Selected Trace — Raw Logs (use Export → CSV when handing off)

search.query: $index_name$ "$trace_filter$" | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N") | eval Service=coalesce(service_name,service,app,application,component,container_name,source) | eval Pod=coalesce(pod,pod_name,kubernetes_pod_name,host) | sort 0 _time | table Time Service Pod source sourcetype _raw

html.div: Logging requirement: every gateway, application service, outbound API client, and database layer should log the same trace_id or correlation_id. Without that shared value, Splunk can show API symptoms but cannot reliably reconstruct the complete request journey.
